push.name: Technology push
push.note: Science leads: research looks for its market.
push.label: Technology push: research, market, IP, finance, execution

pull.name: Market pull
pull.note: Demand leads: the market sets the research agenda.
pull.label: Market pull: market, research, IP, finance, execution

coupled.name: Coupling
coupled.note: Push and pull at once: lab, product development and market iterate through constant feedback loops.
coupled.label: Coupling model: research and market together, then IP, finance and execution, linked by feedback loops

open.name: Open innovation
open.note: The boundary opens: unused patents are licensed out; external ideas, patents and startups come in.
open.label: Open innovation: IP flows in and out across research, market, finance and execution

helix.name: Triple helix
helix.note: The state funds and regulates; university creates knowledge, company produces: value comes from their interaction.
helix.label: Triple helix: state finance, university research and company market interact, then IP and execution

dynamic.name: Dynamic model
dynamic.note: Success depends on the receiver: its absorptive capacity and innovation culture, not only the technology.
dynamic.label: Dynamic model: research to execution, decided by absorptive capacity and innovation culture
dynamic.caption: Absorptive capacity · Innovation culture → Execution

catchup.name: Catch-up
catchup.note: Copy proven production first, then assimilate, improve and innovate: the route of Japan and South Korea.
catchup.label: Catch-up: from execution and market back to IP and own research
catchup.caption: Imitate → Assimilate → Improve → Innovate

design.name: Design-driven
design.note: Neither push nor pull: innovation changes what a product means, as the Wii turned gaming into family play.
design.label: Design-driven innovation: a new meaning frames research, market, IP, finance and execution
design.caption: Meaning first: a new reason to use the product

malik.name: Communication (Malik)
malik.note: University sends, company receives, technology is the message: success means removing the noise between science and business.
malik.label: Malik communication model: university sender, technology message, company receiver

mayer.name: Intermediary (Mayer-Blass)
mayer.note: Technology cannot leave the lab as it is: a transfer office translates the discovery into an opportunity investors understand.
mayer.label: Mayer-Blass intermediary model: research, translated by a transfer office through IP, into an investor case
mayer.caption: Lab discovery → TTO translation → Investor case

gorschek.name: 7 steps (Gorschek)
gorschek.note: Brings academic software engineering to industry: seven steps from a real company problem to controlled tests in production.
gorschek.label: Gorschek seven-step model: company problem, research solution, controlled production pilot
gorschek.caption: 7 steps: real problem → lab solution → production pilot

bozeman.name: Contingent (Bozeman)
bozeman.note: No single metric such as royalties: effectiveness depends on agent, object, recipient, channel and impact on society.
bozeman.label: Bozeman contingent effectiveness: agent, object, recipient, channel and social impact

lean.name: Lean startup
lean.note: As in NSF I-Corps: scientists build an MVP and interview hundreds of customers before patenting or producing at scale.
lean.label: Lean startup: research, MVP and customer interviews before IP and finance

tas.name: Application selection
tas.note: A breakthrough looking for its market: characterize what makes it unique, identify industries it could serve, select the lowest barrier.
tas.label: Technology application selection: characterize, identify and select the market

anglo.name: Anglo-Saxon
anglo.note: Regional model (Rubiralta): intellectual property first, fast spin-off creation and venture capital funding.
anglo.label: Anglo-Saxon model: IP, spin-off and venture capital
anglo.caption: IP → Spin-off → Venture capital

central.name: Central European
central.note: Regional model: applied research institutes, like Fraunhofer in Germany, funded jointly by the state and private contracts.
central.label: Central European model: applied research institutes with public and private funding
central.caption: Applied institutes · State + private contracts

nordic.name: Nordic
nordic.note: Regional model: strong social cohesion and public funds aimed at sustainability and digitalization.
nordic.label: Nordic model: public funds for sustainability and digitalization
nordic.caption: Public funds → Sustainability · Digitalization

thesis.title: Executive thesis
thesis.p: Science ventures fail when research, market, IP, finance and execution move as disconnected languages.
thesis.h2: My work is to translate them into one investment-grade operating narrative.

meta.content: Ki Natural Science case: turning Colombian biodiversity science into investable venture value.
meta.title: Ki Natural Science Case | CV Profile

hero.span: Real impact case · Ki Natural Science S.A.S.
hero.span_2: Science venture structuring · Biodiversity · Sustainable innovation
hero.h1: Turning Colombian biodiversity science into investable venture value
hero.p: Ki Natural Science presents a science-based innovation platform that converts botanical knowledge, clean technologies and biobased product development into solutions for industry, communities and territories.
hero.label: Case actions
hero.card-title: Corporate spin-off prepared for capital logic
hero.p_2: The work focused on translating a broad scientific and technology portfolio into an investor-ready narrative: venture thesis, value story, strategic assets, partner logic and scalable market pathways.

case-proof-strip.label: Ki Natural Science public signals
case-proof-strip.span: Cold botanical extraction technology designed for cleaner, standardized industrial transfer.
case-proof-strip.span_2: Controlled cultivation device for functional mushrooms with autonomous environmental management.
case-proof-strip.span_3: Product research spanning botanical beverages, ingredients, aromas and functional experiences.
case-proof-strip.span_4: Technology transfer and training with communities, including the Wila ancestral reserve in Cauca.

video.p: A visual reference for understanding the company, its science-based positioning and the kind of venture narrative behind the case.

challenge.p: The company had more than a product story. It had science, prototypes, intellectual assets, sustainability claims, regulated-market opportunities, community transfer and multiple possible commercialization routes.
challenge.p_2: Organized technologies, services and products into a coherent platform thesis for capital and partners.
challenge.strong_2: From lab language to buyer logic
challenge.p_3: Reframed technical capabilities around industrial problems, transferability and repeatable value creation.
challenge.p_4: Connected intangible assets, growth options and execution milestones to a credible investor conversation.

role.p: The contribution was not just advisory language. It was venture structuring: making the business legible to investors, institutions and strategic partners while preserving the scientific and sustainability core.
role.p_2: Positioned KNS as a science venture platform across extraction, cultivation, biobased products and ERSA advisory.
role.p_3: Clarified how prototypes, know-how, transfer potential and sustainability outcomes support valuation.
role.p_4: Built the investor-facing logic around market pathways, milestones, risk reduction and execution leverage.

evidence.p: Connect Bogota lists the case under its research-results transfer services, connecting the program Sacale Jugo a Tu Patente, Ki Cannabic Science, RIPPLE and the spin-off TORCH.
evidence.strong: De la invencion a la innovacion
evidence.p_2: Connect Bogota reports that, through this Minciencias and SIC program, Ki Cannabic Science reached an agreement with the Puerto Rican company RIPPLE to create the spin-off TORCH, valued at US$14.3 million.

outcome.h2: A science company became easier to understand, value and scale.
outcome.blockquote: The case demonstrates the profile's core thesis: deep science creates more enterprise value when its technology, market, community, sustainability and capital stories move as one operating narrative.
